name: crate-provider
title: CrateProvider
description: Sets labels and locale for every crate wait state, so all text can be replaced or translated.

head: Prop
Type
Required
Default
Notes
rows: Any labels to replace. Missing ones fall back to English.
BCP 47 locale for numbers, times, and plurals, e.g. "fr" or "ar-EG". Inherited when omitted.

blocks.text: Every label key, with its English default. Labels with a number are functions that receive the value and a locale formatter (`f.number`, `f.seconds`, `f.plural`).

rows.code: "The agent wants to send this email"

blocks.code:
import { CrateProvider, type CrateLabels } from "@/components/agent-wait-states";

const fr: Partial<CrateLabels> = {
  thinking: "Réflexion…",
  stillThinking: "Toujours en réflexion…",
  cancel: "Annuler",
  done: "Terminé",
  retry: "Réessayer",
  error: "Une erreur est survenue.",
  showThinking: "Afficher le raisonnement",
  thoughtFor: (seconds, f) => `Réflexion pendant ${f.seconds(seconds)}`,
  moreSources: (count, f) => `+${f.number(count)} ${f.plural(count, { one: "autre", other: "autres" })}`,
  planProgress: (current, total, f) => `${f.number(current)} sur ${f.number(total)}`,
  expiresIn: (seconds, f) => `Expire dans ${f.seconds(seconds)}`,
  deny: "Refuser",
  allow: "Autoriser",
  queuePosition: (position, f) => `Vous êtes n° ${f.number(position)} dans la file`,
};

<CrateProvider locale="fr" labels={fr}>
  <AgentState status={status} />
</CrateProvider>

name: agent-state
title: AgentState
description: A state wrapper that renders and transitions the complete wait-state set.

head: Prop
Type
Required
Default
Notes
rows: Replace any of this component's labels. Overrides CrateProvider.
How long a tool call or sources stay on screen at least, in ms. One that ends sooner stays, shown as finished, until this has passed. Errors, approvals, and stalls never wait. 0 turns it off.

blocks.text: `status` is an `AgentStatus` string or the snapshot from `useAgentStatus`. Each state renders one component:
Pass `labels` to override labels for whichever state is showing. See the CrateProvider doc for every key.

name: agent-stream
title: AgentStream
description: Streams any AI backend into useAgentStatus: one small event format, server-sent events in and out (including a raw SSE adapter), and the useAgentStream hook.

blocks.code:
import { agentStreamText, reduceAgentStream, readSSE, agentEventsFromSSE, agentEventsToSSE, agentEventsResponse } from "@/lib/agent-stream";
import { useAgentStream } from "@/hooks/use-agent-stream";

blocks.text: agentStreamText
All text streamed so far in the current turn.
reduceAgentStream
Applies one event to the state. Pure, so it works with useReducer or anywhere else.
readSSE
Parses a server-sent events body into messages, following the SSE format.
agentEventsFromSSE

blocks.code: agentEventsFromSSE(body: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, map: SSEMapper = defaultSSEMapper): AsyncGenerator<AgentStreamEvent>

blocks.text: The raw SSE adapter: reads any server-sent events stream as AgentStreamEvents.
agentEventsToSSE
Encodes AgentStreamEvents as server-sent events. Errors thrown by the source become an error event.
agentEventsResponse
A streaming Response for route handlers (Next.js, Hono, Remix, and others).
useAgentStream

blocks.code: useAgentStream({ api = "/api/agent", fetch: request, map }: UseAgentStreamOptions = {}): AgentStream

blocks.text: Streams a response from any backend that sends server-sent events, and returns the chat shape useAgentStatus reads: useAgentStatus(useAgentStream(...)).
